name: LIL BOOKS STORE
description:
Lil Books Store is a book brand that offers a range of books for young children to inculcate their reading habits. As an ardent supporter of the saying "There is no Enjoyment like Reading," Lil Books Store aims to promote reading habits and instill a love for literature in children.

One of the main products offered by Lil Books Store is Amar Chitra Katha, a popular Indian comic book series that narrates stories from Indian mythology, history, and folklore. Amar Chitra Katha is known for its captivating illustrations and engaging storytelling that make learning about India's rich heritage and culture a fun and exciting experience for children.

Lil Books Store is committed to offering books that not only entertain but also educate children.

featured_reviews.review_text: My friend took me here for the 1st time today and I was amazed!! Even though it's a smaller book store, somehow there is an endless variety of books and so many different genres!! So many beautiful covers and attractive titles I saw today. Needless to say I will come back to purchase books especially from the impressive children's selection for my little brother♡ It inspired me to start a collection of my own, my empty shelves are catching dust😅

featured_reviews.name: Riya Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Granth Book Store in Juhu recently and honestly felt a little disappointed with the overall customer experience. A bookstore is usually expected to feel welcoming and comfortable for readers, but the staff behavior did not reflect that warmth.

While I was casually clicking pictures of the bookstore, one of the helpers stopped me and said photography was not allowed. What felt confusing was that the Google reviews of the same store already contain several visitor-clicked photos. If photography policies exist, they should at least be communicated politely and consistently.
Another uncomfortable part of the experience was the way the staff constantly observed us while we were browsing books, almost as if customers were being viewed with suspicion rather than trust. Browsing peacefully is one of the most enjoyable parts of visiting a bookstore, and unfortunately that comfort was missing here.
The bookstore itself has a lovely collection, which is why I genuinely hope the management works on creating a more welcoming and customer-friendly environment for book lovers.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for sharing your feedback and for appreciating our book collection.

We are sorry that your experience at Granth Book Store, Juhu did not feel as welcoming as it should have. Creating a comfortable environment for readers is very important to us.

Regarding photography, we do have a “No Photography” signage displayed at the store as part of our guidelines. While we do try to communicate this consistently, there may have been instances where it was missed. We also understand your concern about how the situation may have felt, and we will ensure our team handles such interactions more politely and respectfully.

We are also sorry that you felt observed while browsing. This is certainly not the experience we aim to create for our customers.

Your feedback has been noted seriously, and we will work on improving the overall in-store experience.

We truly appreciate your feedback and hope to welcome you again soon.
